# TopologyAwareDisturbanceModel

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A disturbance model that incorporates network topology information (e.g., graph structure, link delays) into the observer design. Enables disturbance compensation that is aware of the underlying communication fabric, improving robustness in distributed neuromorphic systems.
